existing33_79: Preserve all data, labels, roles, seals.33 one-positive/2-3 candidates makes Top3 trivial;186 permutations repeat33 parents; position2=28/33. No historical rewrites.
quota_limits: Coverage targets, not prevalence or acquired samples. No padding with fixtures, seeds, types, paraphrases, caption variants or independent-sample claims. Missing5/8 genuine candidate mechanisms =>HOLD. All inspected20/60 stay development; separately acquire protected final.

controls.hard_negatives: Every verified0/1/many parent includes>=1 plausible minimal semantic error; varied failure causes, not just lexical mismatch. Faithful captions and independent finite counterexamples; never force candidate failure.
controls.unknowns: U-only candidates excluded from training labels/weight but retained in evaluation/coverage/fallback cost. Known F+U may support negative via explicit counterexample only, while preserving all unknown predicates. Missing API channels cannot be fabricated.
controls.positions: Freeze label-independent block/seed/order before outcomes. Final verified1 intended-position targets:48/slot at5,30/slot at8. Small stages report incomplete position coverage; actual positives are not moved after observation to fit a target.
controls.style_lexical: Two faithful styles, matched lengths/mechanism detail, neutral internal names, no correct/reference/wrong badges. Preserve essential negation/condition semantics rather than falsifying captions to equalize word overlap. Freeze fixed order/position2/BM25/lexical/Go-rule controls; choose strongest only on development, never final.
controls.replays: At most4 predeclared presentations for each of20 audit parents,<=80 presentations and20 distinct parents. Replays/translation variants stay in parent connected groups.

graph_roles: Audit transitive shared-source/helper/template/fork/alias, negative-candidate source, parents/children/siblings and translation links before scores/roles. Shared author and generic stdlib use remain disclosed limits, not independence proof. New60 may target>=6 connected groups with3/2/1 train/selection/calibration groups from PDCA; this does not replace historical audit/minima or establish sufficient breadth. No numeric assignment. Group merges/rights deficits remain HOLD, never split groups or reassign33/79.
final_source_policy: New final groups/repositories disjoint from inspected train/development/selection/calibration/tuned variants. Preserve published >=30 final repositories and<=10% per repository as targets, plus actual whole-lineage audit. Literal repository-name mismatch or2400 rows does not prove independent N.
new_authority_schema_required: Separate Root qualification/materializer/Reader version must express full candidate sets up to8, zero/one/multi acceptable sets, candidate/predicate T/F/U, ambiguous interpretation, eligibility/mask and exact role/group pins. Do not silently broaden current one-positive33 contracts; no Root truth assigned here.

stages.purpose: 10cells×2; freeze source/notices, literal observables, candidate/style/order and accounting.
stages.stop: duplicate/padding, missing ABI/rights/observability, leakage, U->F, inconsistent acceptance or unexplained baseline mismatch.

stages.purpose: 10cells×6, one of each6 behavior per cell. Whole-group source-held-out controls and oracle check-headroom screen.
stages.stop: strongest nonlearned control already optimal or oracle maximum relative gain<5%; no family-held-out coverage, style/position shortcut or missing cost/quality/resource evidence. No automatic Fit.

stages.role: new protected final per claimed domain
stages.purpose: Freeze policy, acceptance, controls, calibration, selected model and budget before outcome access. Per cell60/48/48/36/24/24 by public behavior categories=240.
stages.stop: final exposure/tuning, linked-group contamination, missing rights/costs/acceptance or admission. Report target/acquired/excluded/qualified/attempted/completed separately.

metrics: Known answerable: Top1/nontrivial AnyHit@3/first acceptable rank and checks/all-positive recall@k, by candidate/answer counts. Mark structurally guaranteed top-k cells. Zero: finite-set false acceptance/abstention/exhaustive work. U/ambiguity: coverage, unsupported acceptance, fallback cost and whole-parent denominators; no invented accuracy. Report parents/groups/replays/processes and family-cluster uncertainty;2400 is not effective N.

paired_work_cost.screen: Saved qualified finite truth may later bound ordering checks; oracle is neither feature nor deployment policy. No baseline/oracle computation now.
paired_work_cost.future_pair: Separately admitted matched task/candidate/source snapshots, independent acceptance, predeclared counterbalanced arms and fresh owned state. Include hint preparation/startup/features/scoring/order, verification, failures, abstention/fallback/escalation and integration/merge. Retries only if separately authorized; preserve all attempts and missingness.
paired_work_cost.units: Checks/calls/wall/CPU/token subsets/currency/quotas remain separate observed units. Unknown=null. Simulated check reduction is not actual Codex tokens/money/time. Report cold/warm/cache and predeclared amortization; acquisition/training/index construction separate.
paired_work_cost.gate: Keep existing>=5% check reduction and no-quality-regression. Additionally propose>=5% lower prespecified total measured verification-work metric after hint/fallback overhead, with paired uncertainty and harmful strata retained. Extra practical gate not yet adopted.

model_lineage: Fixed FP32 fitted parent; INT8/PTQ derived children of that parent; separately trained ternary-STE sibling. These are not independent user samples. Preserve existing fits/artifacts/failures. First prove FP32 usefulness; storage/quantization, packed runtime/RSS and ternary training utility remain separate experiments; small files do not prove1.58-bit operations or savings.
domain_separation: Claim/candidate ordering is not profile-routing, repository or decomposition truth. Each claimed domain needs separate>=2400 protected parents/oracle. Routing retains paired both-success/small-only/large-only/both-fail plus whole costs; decomposition groups all children/siblings and judges parent completion+merge, not DAG count.
